body:
What version of InstantSearch are you using? (this documentation is for the v2). Also it would be helpful if you could recreate your issue in [codesandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js-2.x), so we can help out more effectively.

From my tests `transformItems` seems to be working correctly. One issue with the example is that it's using `{{{_highlightResult.name.value}}}` and this highlight helper only works on the original `hit` value (even if it was transformed). I agree that it can be confusing and we should fix this example.
